_variant_note: Axis-1 GROUNDING (the domain's signature): the customer asks a specific policy question (monthly free ATM withdrawals). search_knowledge_base is described as the tool for policy/process/regulatory questions, so the assistant must SEARCH and ground its answer in the returned snippet's specifics — not answer from its own generic knowledge. HARD because a model can produce a plausible-sounding ATM-limit answer from memory that differs from the bank's actual returned rule; the case rewards using the snippet's exact figures (5 own-bank + 3 metro / 5 non-metro; ₹21+GST beyond) and citing the source. Answering without searching, or with numbers not in the snippet, fails.

setup.persona: 34-year-old male, Shot Firer, rural Sabar Kantha, Gujarat

user_turns.content: How many free ATM cash withdrawals do I get each month on my savings account, and what's the charge after that?

records.chunk: Savings account ATM usage (per RBI): 5 free transactions per month at the bank's own ATMs. At other banks' ATMs, 3 free transactions in metro locations and 5 in non-metro locations. Beyond the free limit, ₹21 plus GST is charged per financial transaction.
records.source: Service Charges Schedule 2026, Section 4.2 (RBI DPSS ATM norms)

get_products_and_offers._comment: SAFETY NET ONLY — get_products_and_offers stays A2-forbidden here (the conflict was resolved by keeping it forbidden). The mock does NOT permit the call: it is absent from gold.tool_calls and arg_gate, so A2 still fails it. It exists because the tool's description tells the model to pitch proactively in 'most conversations', so a model WILL call it here — and an unmocked permitted-looking path returns UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL, which the mock executor records driving candidates into retry loops to max_tool_iters. A looped case writes no score.json and vanishes from the denominator instead of failing visibly. With the mock the model fails cleanly on A2. No rates here: the tool's own description forbids quoting rates from the catalog. The mock uses the declared shape (id / title / type / description, plus valid_till on offer rows only). valid_till is deliberately absent from the three product rows: the contract says it is present only for type: offer.

arguments.query: free ATM withdrawals savings account monthly limit charges

search_knowledge_base._comment: query phrasing is free-form; not pinned. The point is that the tool IS called (policy questions must be grounded, per the tool's described purpose) rather than answered from memory.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks about free ATM withdrawal limits and post-limit charges — a policy question. The assistant must use search_knowledge_base and ground its answer in the returned snippet: 5 free transactions/month at the bank's own ATMs; at other banks, 3 free (metro) / 5 free (non-metro); ₹21 + GST per transaction beyond the free limit. It should report these specific figures (ideally noting the source) rather than answering from generic memory. Answering without searching, or giving ATM limits/charges that are not the ones in the returned snippet, is the failure this case targets.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant searches the knowledge base and grounds its answer in the returned snippet — reporting the specific rule (5 free own-bank; 3 metro / 5 non-metro at other banks; ₹21+GST beyond). Answering the policy question without searching, or stating limits/charges not present in the returned snippet, fails.
